title: Field-manual restyle keeps vendored tokens, derives the rest
rationale: The ui-revamp direction A mockups are the chosen design; the vendored warren-theme.css cannot be edited, so type roles and extra neutral steps are site-owned overrides that load after it

title: Landing copy sells the control plane, not the run
rationale: The brand guide's load-bearing test: a sentence whose subject is the agent is table stakes; the subject must be warren or the operator. Marketing copy also drops endpoint paths, rubric-class counts, and point-in-time stats: readers who want mechanics read the docs
